kunkka_admirals_rum.name: Admiral's Rum
kunkka_admirals_rum.description: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below %damage_threshold%%% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to %ghostship_absorb%%% of incoming damage for %buff_duration%s.
kunkka_admirals_rum.lore: Deleterious to landlubbers, no one holds their rum like a sailor.
kunkka_admirals_rum.note0: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

kunkka_torrent.name: Torrent
kunkka_torrent.description: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
kunkka_torrent.lore: An ancestral rush of water explodes from the center of the world, called upon by the Admiral.
kunkka_torrent.note0: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
kunkka_torrent.note1: Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.
kunkka_torrent.storm_custom_description: Releases a visible Torrent in a random area around Kunkka once every %torrent_interval% for %torrent_duration% seconds. Spawns within %torrent_max_distance% range of him.
kunkka_torrent.storm_custom_lore: A hundred leagues of dry land couldn't keep these seas at bay.

kunkka_tidebringer.name: Tidebringer
kunkka_tidebringer.description: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
kunkka_tidebringer.facet_kunkka_high_tide: Tidebringer cooldown is reduced per enemy hero it hits.
kunkka_tidebringer.lore: A lost Claddish soul inhabits Kunkka's trusty Tidebringer, empowering it to destroy demons of the Cataract.

kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.name: X Marks the Spot
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.facet_kunkka_grog: When X Marks the Spot returns its target, Kunkka and allies near the return spot gain Ghostship's Admiral's Rum buff.
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.description: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.lore: The Admiral's set of arcane abilities includes some that can be used for battle as well as entertainment.
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.note0: If the target becomes Spell Immune after the cast, the target will not return to the X after the duration.

kunkka_ghostship.name: Ghostship
kunkka_ghostship.description:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
kunkka_ghostship.lore: The final ship of the Claddish Navy is nothing but a phantom, but it is all too real to the enemies of the Admiral.
kunkka_ghostship.scepter_description: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
kunkka_ghostship.note0: The impact area of the shipwreck is larger than the ship itself.
kunkka_ghostship.note1: The ship moves at a speed of %ghostship_speed%.
